# 4. Example Files

## 4.1. Example Collection

Collect the ExampleScheduler logs and the ExampleLauncher logs. The DMS_ExampleScheduler and ExampleSched names count too.

## 4.2. Example Hosts

Instances DMS_ExampleHost_7 and DMS_ExampleHost_8 belong to the ExampleHost pool.
